cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Outsmart the Room
cards.instruction: Turn every clue, deduction, and secret into a contest you must solve or control first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've put my conclusion above yours on the board.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then chronology decides who outsmarted whom.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My chalk reached the board first.
